rules: position_line.template is filled by slot substitution ONLY. The renderer never composes or rewords the sentence, and no model call touches this path.
blocks are immutable at runtime: no summarisation, no rewriting for length, no tone adjustment. If a block is too long for a viewport, that is a layout problem.
Every string marked [Education content to be written ...] is a PLACEHOLDER. Devon and Charlie write the real copy; it must never be improvised by a model or a developer.
Slots suffixed _display (statuses, counts, descriptions) are formatted by the deterministic renderer from the listed fields — formatting, never characterisation.
A missing field renders as 'none recorded', never as zero. (Fixture H, field-spec 3.6.)
